metaTitle: All your banks, one clear picture

hero.title: All your banks. One clear picture.
hero.description: Bring the statements from every bank you use into one place and see where your money really goes, so you can understand your spending habits.

banks.title: Works with the banks you already use
banks.legend: Larger logos have a dedicated statement reader; the rest are read with the generic one.

upload.title: Upload your statements
upload.description: Download the monthly PDF statement from each bank and drop them in. No bank passwords needed.

sort.title: Everything gets sorted
sort.description: Every transaction is categorized automatically, and transfers between your own accounts are left out of your spending.

understand.title: Understand your habits
understand.description: See what you spend on each category, month after month, across all your accounts together.

oneView.title: One view, every account
oneView.description: Salary in one bank, card in another, savings in a third? See them side by side and as a single total, instead of logging in to three apps.

habits.title: Spot where your money goes
habits.description: Monthly trends by category show what's growing, what's steady and where you could cut back. Teach it once and your own rules apply from then on.

together.title: Built for two
together.description: Invite your partner to share a household. Shared accounts are split fairly, and any account can stay private.

security.title: Your data stays yours
security.description: Reading your finances shouldn't mean handing them over.

noLogin.title: No bank logins
noLogin.description: You upload statements yourself. We never ask for your banking credentials and can't move money.

encrypted.title: Encrypted at rest
encrypted.description: Statement files are encrypted before they're stored, and account numbers are never kept in plain text.

private.title: Processed privately
private.description: Statements are read and categorized by our own code. They're never sent to AI services or third parties.

finalCta.title: Get the full picture of your finances
finalCta.description: Start with last month's statements. It takes a few minutes.
